speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked the Minister for Health what assistance does the Ministry provide to Community Health Assist Scheme-registered clinics so that the doctors and clinic staff can better advise patients on their options.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: MOH regularly reviews these guidelines to ensure they remain in line with best practices.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) works closely with MOH to support CHAS clinics in scheme participation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: AIC also publishes articles in professional newsletters, and issues regular mailers to CHAS clinics, to highlight key updates on matters of relevance to GPs, and alert them to potential practice pitfalls.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: CHAS clinics can also contact their AIC account managers for assistance and clarifications on the scheme.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: With a higher number of Singaporeans who will be eligible for CHAS moving forward and for us to better serve them, would the Ministry consider providing clearer guidelines to these CHAS clinics on the specific subsidies for specialist referrals?

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: This information is available to CHAS GPs through AIC's various engagement platforms, and we will continue to reach out to CHAS GPs to inform and update CHAS GPs and dental clinics on clinical and claims guidelines, especially so when there are new initiatives being rolled out.
